Large cold room with stable empty center and unobstructed central foreground floor. Dense realistic aged hospital materials: scuffed insulated panels, worn seams, condensation at metal edges, slight frost only around cabinet seals, dusty concrete and restrained moisture sheen, old ceiling conduit. Cold cyan-white fluorescent ceiling light, a little dim neutral ambient reflection, dark teal-blue shadows; no warm heroic spotlight and no reward glow. Cinematic photorealistic game environment illustration, crisp believable textures, sober tense clinical mood, readable midtones with no obscuring fog. Central x=25%-75% y=60%-95% is empty low-contrast floor for independently rendered gameplay interface. No person, NPC, enemy, corpse, silhouette, blood, gore or human reflection.
